row:
The Mobile Vet Nurse has been providing premium in-home veterinary nursing and preventative health care for companion pets since 2010.

Based in Christchurch, New Zealand our services are carried out in the comfort of your own home. This puts your pet at ease during treatments, check-ups and pampering sessions - your pet’s comfort is our biggest concern. All services include complimentary cuddles and treats!

The Mobile Vet Nurse YouTube channel shows great videos posted every week, so check back every day! We provide advice for different health issues related to pets, helpful tutorials, and a behind-the-scenes look at daily life into the world of our Vet Nurses!
